lessons.title: Build one face
lessons.text: Choose any color and gather its four stickers on one face. The side colors do not need to match yet. Put that face underneath; keep it there for OLL.
lessons.exercise: Build a face on three different colors. Notice the difference between a finished face and a finished layer.

lessons.title: Orient the opposite face
lessons.text: Use one of seven OLL cases to make the top one color. Ignore the side colors for now. These are corner patterns: familiar 3×3 moves can help, but 2×2 recognition is a separate skill.
lessons.exercise: Use an example setup below on a solved 2×2. Observe where the top-color stickers point, then apply its algorithm without changing your grip.

lessons.title: Permute both layers
lessons.text: With both opposite faces oriented, inspect the side stickers on each layer. A matching pair is a bar. A layer has four bars when solved, one for an adjacent swap, or none for a diagonal swap. Select PBL using both layers; finish with top/bottom adjustments. Turn the cube over if only the bottom needs a swap.
lessons.exercise: Build each example, count bars on both layers, then solve. Review marks track reading only; recognition practice and a 2×2 player will come later.
